name: polish
description: Personal collection of curated, self-made, and adapted agent skills for Fusion-enhanced multi-model deliberation and niche knowledge relay (model-council), AI Agent & Harness engineering (KV-cache context, MCP tools, AST-scanned harness hardening, multi-agent workflows, memory & RAG, async/voice/GUI ingress, paired evaluation, skill auditing), longitudinal time-series chronicle synthesis, prompt rewriting, defect investigation, project-wide contract exploration, domain modeling, deep-module design, frontend design quality, repository workflows, and release safety.

interface.shortDescription: Curated personal skills for agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Polish is a personal collection of curated, self-made, and adapted agent skills. It includes model-council (Fusion-enhanced blind multi-model synthesis and long-tail knowledge-distribution relay), an 8-skill AI Agent & Harness engineering suite (skill auditing, KV-cache context architecture, Poka-yoke MCP tools, AST-scanned harness hardening, multi-agent workflows, dual-layer memory & RAG, async/voice/GUI ingress, paired evaluation & self-evolution), longitudinal time-series chronicle and Sankey synthesis, cross-agent local session takeover, prompt rewriting, probabilistic decision analysis and risk threshold inversion, uncertainty-first defect investigation, project-wide contract exploration, duplicate-file planning, pre-push risk review, portable frontend taste, design-system extraction, brief enhancement, shadcn/ui implementation guidance, prefixed Superpowers workflows, and prefixed Matt Pocock engineering skills (domain modeling, deep-module design, grilling, prototyping, primary-source research, two-axis code review, interactive setup wizards, and writing for agents). git-commit-message drafts and reviews messages using GitLab and GitHub conventions. consistent-term-translation-polish-guard provides English-Chinese translation and polishing with stable terminology and acronym bindings.
